bio.text: Joni Ernst was elected to the U.S. Senate from Iowa in November 2014.
She previously served as Montgomery County Auditor and as a state senator, and retired as a Lieutenant Colonel in the Iowa Army National Guard after 23 years of military service.
Born in 1970 in Red Oak, Iowa, she graduated from Iowa State University and holds a master's degree from Columbus State University; she lives in Red Oak.
